verdict.rationale: Amplitude explicitly documents managing flags, experiments, and deployments "from CI, scripts, or your own tools" via the Experiment APIs. A broad REST surface backs this up: HTTP V2 ingest, event export, Dashboard REST API, cohort and taxonomy APIs, and a probed OpenAPI spec, so core workflows can be automated headlessly without the UI. missing for 10: a documented non-interactive or CI mode for the Wizard CLI, CI-specific guidance (auth tokens, pipeline examples) beyond Experiment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
